notes: COBE-FIRAS CMB spectral distortion limit on photon-to-dark-photon kinetic mixing epsilon vs dark photon mass, from resonant gamma->A' conversions before recombination, 95% C.L. Main new result covers ~1e-9 to 1e-4 eV (y-era, mu-y transition, mu-era, T-era). No numerical table is provided; data_points are read approximately from Figs 4-5, where the fiducial constraint is roughly flat at epsilon ~ (2-3)e-8 and weakens (rises) toward high mass in the T-era and near the HeIII->HeII notch at mA'~1e-8 eV. Analytic estimate Eq.(6) gives epsilon ~ 3e-8. Free-streaming era (mA' < 1e-10 eV) reproduces Ref.[43]. Paper also gives a PIXIE projection (not extracted here).
